name: std-learn-hotspot
description: Generic spatial tap-to-identify instrument — a config-declared roster of labeled hotspots (id, label, x, y, radius, color) renders on a learning-canvas, and a config-declared prompt roster asks the learner to tap the right part directly on the canvas: a first-try hit scores, a miss names what was actually tapped and invites another try, and a hit reveals the part's explanation with a highlight ring before advancing. All vocabulary is config-declared, so the same mechanism serves any labeled scene: organs on a cell, countries on a sketch map, components on a circuit, bones on a skeleton. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

emits.description: The verdict of a canvas tap: whether the right part was hit, which prompt it was, and how many misses preceded it — a composed listener (coach, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: hotspot, tap the part, spatial identification, point at, label the diagram

emits.description: The learner moved to the next prompt (or completed the round) with the running first-try score.
The learner restarted the round from scratch.
Fired once when the round finishes (advancing past the final prompt) — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.

events.name: Mode Selected
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: Tap Shape
events.description: Learner tapped a shape on the canvas — the canvas callback wraps its click info as payload { id, type, index }; the id names the hotspot (or its label) and the tap is judged against the current prompt's target.

events.name: Next
events.description: Learner advanced to the next prompt after finding the current target; past the last prompt this completes the round.

events.name: Retry
events.description: Learner restarted the round from the first prompt with a cleared score.

events.name: Tap Judged
events.description: The verdict of a canvas tap: whether the right part was hit, which prompt it was, and how many misses preceded it — a composed listener (coach, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: hotspot, tap the part, spatial identification, point at, label the diagram

events.name: Prompt Advanced
events.description: The learner moved to the next prompt (or completed the round) with the running first-try score.

events.name: Round Restarted
events.description: The learner restarted the round from scratch.

events.name: Learn Round Complete
events.description: Fired once when the round finishes (advancing past the final prompt) — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.
